programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Assembly of a PM2000 Table Saw
programme.desc: I have been running a PM2000 in my shop for nearly 10 years and the move to Colorado afforded me the opportunity to sell the old one and replace it with a newer version that features a 50″ fence and the heavier duty workbench extension. And I thought it would be a good time to show you how to assemble a Powermatic PM2000.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: How to Setup & Tune a Tablesaw Part 2
programme.desc: In the second and final part of our tablesaw setup series, we continue our quest for fine tuning. Topics include setting the blade bevel angle, adjusting fence alignment with the blade, adjust fence so that it is square to the table, setting up the insert, and lining up the splitter.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Buy This Not That - Measuring and Marking
programme.desc: Tools I think you should buy as well as tools I think you should avoid.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Assembly Table Stand
programme.desc: In this episode, learn with Marc how to create a stable assembly table stand that will hold even the heaviest table.

programme.desc: I'm auctioning off my old Roubo workbench for charity and built a new Hybrid Workbench to replace it.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Powermatic PM2244 Drum Sander Mini Review
programme.desc: Powermatic recently released their new drum sander, the PM2244, and I've been getting a lot of questions about it. A drum sander is a huge investment so it pays to do your research and make sure you get the right unit for your shop.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Shaping a Maloof-Inspired Rocker Spindle
programme.desc: A look at the process I use to create a beautiful sculpted rocker spindle.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Knock Down Trestle Table Part 1
programme.desc: The table is a trestle design which keeps the legs out of the way and gives us plenty of overhang. The joinery is all mortise and tenon including some cool double wedged mortise and tenon joints. I even added extra supports in the middle of the table that will not only support the top but should also help keep the table top flat over time.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: The 10-Minute Spinning Top
programme.desc: A few weeks back, I visited professional turner and instructor Matt Monaco's shop in Phoenix, AZ. I was there to film a segment for a recent Guild project but Matt also offered to show us how he turns a spinning top in under ten minutes! He does it all with a roughing gouge and a skew chisel.

programme.title: The Wood Whisperer: Advanced Joinery With Darrell Peart and William Ng
programme.desc: As you progress along your woodworking journey, it will become clear that joinery can mean much more than a simple mortise and tenon. When you start to dig a little deeper, you find out that various exotic and mind-boggling joints have been in use for centuries.
